details:
Description

The game keeps Freezing periodically. I have tried Emptying the caches, I checked if it was the beta, I even restarted my PC thinking it was a RAM issue. Nothing worked.

Reproduction Steps

It just appeared. I havent changed the settings in years. There are no reproduction steps as I dont know how this started.

Edit: Found the cause. it was the Selfie Camera Expressions. When it didnt find a camera it lagged the ENTIRE GAME.

I turned the Selfie Expressions off and the issue stopped.

I turned it back on with a Camera plugged into my PC and the lag wasnt there either.

BUT as soon as I plugged the camera out and still had selfie expressions on, the entire game started to lag again.

Thanks to the log i found the Issue.

Details

- Category: Performance

- Frequency: Always
